expectations.text: Enumerates several distinct loop shapes / archetypes rather than proposing one vague 'keep improving it' loop
expectations.evidence: "The method has exactly five loop shapes, distinguished by two knobs" and it names Saturator, Exhauster, Converger, and Sentinel as distinct archetypes; opens with "Don't run one 'improve the app' loop."

expectations.text: Maps the concrete candidates to archetypes (e.g. bug backlog or flaky tests -> exhauster; find-all-slow-paths -> saturator; a route to a latency bar -> converger)
expectations.evidence: "Flaky tests -> **Saturator, then Exhauster**", "Slow API routes -> **Converger** (drive to a latency bar)", and "Linear bug backlog -> **Exhauster** (drain a known queue)" -- concrete candidates mapped to archetypes.

expectations.text: Applies a decidability/measurability gate and prefers a candidate with a checkable atom; flags any taste-based candidate
expectations.evidence: Explicit "Decidable?" gate per loop: flaky "Decidable? Yes, strongly... This is an ideal loop"; perf "'make it faster' with no repeatable benchmark and no target is *taste*"; backlog flags "'The dashboard feels janky' -- *not* decidable by a loop" and triages taste-based tickets to a deferred human pass.

expectations.text: Picks ONE loop to run first with a leverage rationale and names the deferred rest as a sequence
expectations.evidence: "**De-flake the test suite first**... Every other loop's definition of 'done' is 'a test passed... and nothing regressed.' If the suite is flaky, that ground truth is a coin flip" -- picks one loop first with leverage rationale, then names deferred rest as a sequence: "Then, in parallel... Optionally, afterward: a standing watch."

expectations.text: Specifies the kernel for the chosen loop: a separate verifier from the worker and counted (not model-scored) progress
expectations.evidence: "**Worker != verifier.** The agent that fixes a ticket never signs off on it" and "**Count, don't vibe.** Progress is `tickets verified / total`... arithmetic in the driver from verified atoms. Not a model-emitted 0-1 score"; for the chosen de-flake loop the verifier is "a *different* agent runs the fixed test 50+ consecutive times."
